v1_3_7.title: Clearer calendar, honest empty states
items: If your data cannot be loaded, the calendar and the day page now say so instead of showing an empty month that looks like lost entries.
Today stays highlighted correctly when the app is left open past midnight.
Opening What’s New now starts at the top of the page.
Screen readers announce a calendar day as a readable date instead of spelling out the raw numbers.

v1_3_6.title: Calmer sign-in
items: Closing the Google window or declining the permissions screen no longer shows a red error — the sign-in button simply becomes available again.
A sign-in that comes back without an expiry time is treated as a normal hour-long session instead of being renewed every second.

v1_3_5.title: Headers stop overlapping as you scroll
items: Scrolling the calendar no longer tucks the card row under the top bar or lets the month controls cover it.
On Reports, the period filter now stays visible while you scroll instead of hiding behind the top bar.

v1_3_4.title: Stays signed in when the connection drops
items: A lost or flaky connection no longer signs you out — your days, cards and payments stay open offline.
A failed sign-in renewal is retried a few times before the app asks you to sign in again.

v1_3_3.title: Entries now line up by time
items: A day's entries are always listed by start time — in the calendar, in the week views and on the day page alike.
Change an entry's time and the day reorders straight away, however many entries it holds.
A new entry lands at its place in the day instead of at the end.
When two entries start at the same time, the longer one comes first — the same way Google Calendar shows them.
In the month grid, the dates from the neighbouring months are easier to read while staying visibly secondary.

v1_3_2.title: Fixed typing on phones
items: In the "Mark paid" and "Remind" dialogs the on-screen keyboard no longer covers the fields and buttons — the form now floats above the keyboard, so the Cancel and Confirm buttons stay reachable.

v1_3_1.title: Smoother Google sign-in
items: Closing the Google sign-in window no longer shows an error — it simply returns you to the login screen so you can try again.

v1_3_0.title: What's New page
items: Added this page listing recent updates — see what changed in the app and how it works.
A "What's New" entry now sits at the bottom of Settings, with a "New" badge until you open the page.

v1_2_0.title: Reminders
items: Create dated reminders with a date and time — e.g. "Collect payment from Marie for July".
Reminders that are due greet you with a banner when you open the app, until you mark them done.
Each reminder is also added to your Google Calendar, and you can quick-create a collection reminder right from the Payments page.

v1_1_0.title: Payments tracking
items: New Payments page: for each client, see the amount expected for a month, how much you've received, and a status — paid, partial, unpaid or overdue.
One tap marks a month as paid (amount and date prefilled), with undo and an editable payment history.
Filter by month; the expected amount matches what your calendar and reports already show.

v1_0_1.title: Mobile drag reschedule fix
items: Fixed dragging an entry to a different day on touch screens — press-and-hold to drag now works reliably.

v1_0_0.title: First stable release
items: Track hours per client with automatic earnings.
Sync with Google Drive and Google Calendar.
Monthly reports with export.
Three interface languages: Ukrainian, English and Spanish.
